h: Tinubu tells Igbo leaders in Lagos he was upset over 2023 votes but they have settled
p: President Tinubu reportedly told Igbo stakeholders in Lagos that he was angry that some of them did not vote for him in 2023, but said the matter had been settled. He urged them to collect their PVCs and vote for him on 16 January.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly told Igbo leaders and stakeholders in Lagos that he expects their votes in the coming presidential election.

Speaking in an informal tone at a meeting on Monday, 23 November 2026, the president acknowledged that some of those present did not vote for him in 2023. He said he had been upset about it at the time, but that both sides had since settled their differences.
He urged them to register, collect their Permanent Voter Cards and vote on 16 January, reminding them of what he described as an agreement between them, and stressing that he is the APC's candidate.
Lagos has a large Igbo population. The NDC's Peter Obi is among Tinubu's main challengers for 2027.
more: Tinubu said he was upset over 2023 but they have settled.
He urged them to collect their PVCs.
